title.zh: 修正西班牙语 su 的学习释义
title.en: Correct the Spanish learner gloss for su

purpose.zh: 修复真实西班牙语 Sprint 第 2 天中 su 被显示为“u的亚种”的内容错误。
purpose.en: Fix the incorrect Chinese gloss for su observed in the signed-in Spanish day-two Sprint.

zh: su 显示名词前的物主限定词含义；同步中文提示和视觉目录。
en: Show the possessive meaning used before nouns; synchronize learner prompts and visual metadata.

zh: 西班牙语初级词汇、每日速成和共享词汇视觉；其他语言的同形词不变。
en: Spanish beginner vocabulary, Sprint and vocabulary visuals; same-form words in other languages are unchanged.

zh: 依据 RAE su 词条新增 0183 幂等数据修正，保留词汇身份和学习记录。
同步常用释义源、视觉源与生成目录，并纳入词库审计重放。
en: Add idempotent migration 0183 based on the RAE su entry, preserving vocabulary IDs and learning records.
Synchronize common overrides, visual source and generated catalog; include the correction in vocabulary audit replay.

zh: 专项测试验证西班牙语释义、意大利语同形词隔离和重复执行无变更。
执行完整构建、测试、lint、类型、迁移、合约、依赖、布局和共享站点门禁；发布后返回真实 Sprint 验证。
en: Focused tests verify the Spanish meaning, isolation of Italian su and idempotency.
Run complete build, tests, lint, types, migrations, contracts, dependency, layout and shared-site gates; retest the real Sprint after deployment.

zh: 本发布不代表每日四语言 QA 全部通过；完整真实会话记录另行报告。
跟读保持关闭，未请求麦克风权限。
en: This release does not claim a passing four-language daily QA run; the complete real-session report is separate.
Repeat-after-me remains off; no microphone permission requested.

zh: SmartLingo 专属学习内容修正，无跨站迁移。
en: SmartLingo-specific learning-content correction; no cross-site rollout.

rollback.zh: 应用可回退至前一已验证提交；正确释义保留。若需更改数据，使用新的前向修正，不回写学习或账本。
rollback.en: Revert application to the previous verified commit while retaining the corrected gloss. Any data correction must use a new forward migration without rewriting activity or ledgers.
